subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can read Welcome to Robot School! and answer questions about times.
I can read Elephant's Day and say when Elephant does things.
I can put story events in order.

tf.s: The robots go to school at eight o'clock.
tf.why: Yes! They go to school at eight o'clock.

tf.s: At Robot School, it's time for lunch at half past twelve.
tf.why: Well done! Lunch is at half past twelve.

tf.s: The robots have art lessons in the morning.
tf.why: They have art lessons in the afternoon.
The story says Robots don't sleep!

tf.s: Robot's drawing is a sports car.
tf.why: Great! Robot draws a sports car.

tf.s: Elephant gets up in the morning.
tf.why: I get up in the morning, says Elephant.
Elephant says I don't go to school. I play!
Yes! He sings in the evening.
Elephant says I don't play at night. I go to bed.

tf.s: The girl says My ears! because Elephant sings very loudly.

boxes.q: What time do the robots go to school?
What do the robots have for lunch?
boxes.why: Lunch is fish, rice and vegetables.

boxes.q: When do the robots have art lessons?
boxes.why: Art lessons are in the afternoon.
He has dinner in the evening.

boxes.q: What time does Elephant go to bed?
boxes.why: It's ten o'clock. I go to bed.

boxes.q: What does the girl say when Elephant sings?

mcq.q: Which sentence is from Welcome to Robot School!?
o: It's half past twelve. It's time for lunch.
I don't go to school. I play!
It's ten o'clock. I go to bed.
mcq.why: Lunch at half past twelve is at Robot School.

mcq.q: Which sentence is from Elephant's Day?
o: We go to school at eight o'clock.
We have art lessons in the afternoon.

mcq.q: What does Elephant do in the afternoon?
What do the robots drink with lunch?
mcq.why: They have fish, rice, vegetables and water.

mcq.q: Complete: Elephant, Elephant, when do you get ___?
Complete: I ___ go to school. I play! (Elephant)
mcq.why: Elephant does not go to school.

mcq.q: Lunch at Robot School is at half past twelve. Where is the minute hand?
mcq.why: Half past means the minute hand is on 6.

mcq.q: Put the Robot School events in order.
o: English lessons, lunch, art lessons, go home
lunch, go home, English lessons, art lessons
art lessons, English lessons, go home, lunch
go home, art lessons, lunch, English lessons
mcq.why: English is first and they go home last.

mcq.q: Does Robot go to bed? Why?
Which retells Elephant's day in the right order?
o: He gets up, plays, sings, goes to bed.
He goes to bed, sings, gets up, plays.
He plays, goes to bed, gets up, sings.
He sings, gets up, goes to bed, plays.
